=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:787-827, 1717-1746 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The release-marker job predicate admits untrusted comments, but AI-memory bootstrap and run-event steps execute before or despite the route step rejecting their authors.
  WHY: Those steps perform GH_PAT-authenticated writes for comments that the route rejects; severity ranged from MAJOR to BLOCKER, so the highest severity is used.
- README.md:488-491 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The documented `ai-clarify.yml` wrapper omits the release-marker clause, so consumers copying it can have their release comments rejected before the reusable workflow runs.
  WHY: The wrapper contract test was loosened to accept the older predicate, leaving the documented example out of parity with the reusable workflow.
- README.md:1426-1428 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The documented wrapper example omits the release-marker clause, so consumers copying it can have their release comments rejected before the reusable workflow runs.
  WHY: The caller job never starts for release comments from a GH_PAT account without a trusted author association.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:276-281 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The README wrapper drift guard accepts the predicate with the release clause removed, so it does not enforce parity with the reusable workflow.
  WHY: The README can omit the new clause while the test still passes, leaving consumers with a wrapper that rejects release comments.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:94-96 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: A failed verified-release run can be replayed with a body that the exact-match release classifier does not recognize, causing the retry to be treated as a human reclarify.
  WHY: The replayed questions receive the human-answer marker and clarify-respond skips them; the poller does not post another release marker. The classifier cited by reviewers is at `.github/workflows/clarify.yml` lines 514-517.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:452-454 | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `test_clarify_route_restarts_a_verified_release_as_automated` returns when `jq` is missing instead of reporting a skip, so the test passes without asserting the release route.
  WHY: On a runner without `jq`, the end-to-end release-path checks do not run.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py:367-374 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The release-marker clause assertion compares substrings of `RELEASE_MARKER_CLAUSE` against that same constant, making the check tautological.
  WHY: It adds no coverage beyond checking that the constant occurs in each wrapper predicate.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The release-marker job predicate admits untrusted comments, but AI-memory start and completion steps run without an author-trust gate.
  WHY: The start step bootstraps memory and records a run event before the route rejects an untrusted author; the completion step is also ungated.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml (`replay_failed_reclarify_commands`, lines 94-96; release classification, lines ~514-517) | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A failed verified-release run can be replayed with a body that the exact-match release classifier does not recognize.
  WHY: The retry is treated as a human reclarify, so the released issue waits for a human answer.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py (`test_clarify_route_restarts_a_verified_release_as_automated`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When `jq` is missing, the test returns without asserting anything instead of reporting a skip.
  WHY: The verified-release path goes untested on such a runner.
- README.md, line 490 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `ai-clarify.yml` wrapper example omits the release-marker clause.
  WHY: Consumers copying it can have release comments rejected by the caller job; the README guard was loosened to accept this drift.
- tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py (`accepted.add(_canonical_predicate(job_name).replace(" || " + RELEASE_MARKER_CLAUSE, ""))`; `_assert_clauses(RELEASE_MARKER_CLAUSE, (...))`) | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The README guard accepts two predicates, and `_assert_clauses` checks substrings of `RELEASE_MARKER_CLAUSE` against that same constant.
  WHY: The self-comparison cannot fail, and the README guard no longer detects the missing clause.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "recognize the exact release marker only after verifying its author is the GH_PAT login ... route that verified comment even if the account lacks a trusted author association ... retain the existing restrictions for ordinary /reclarify comments."
  Expected change site: .github/workflows/clarify.yml "Decide clarify route" and the predicates in clarify.yml, internal-clarify.yml and workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml
  Evidence of absence: Remaining gaps are the README example and telemetry steps that run before the author check.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 2
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: "Complete the intended `_AI_ENGINE_EXIT_REFUSED` engine change in PR #6667 and land that change on main."
  Expected change site: scripts/ai_engine.sh
  Evidence of absence: No hunk touches scripts/ai_engine.sh. AD-1 in the PR description chose to leave this to PR #6667 on `orchestrator/project-6664`, and the changelog and agents.d fragments record that. Reviewer states: "I treat it as deferred, not a gap."
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 1
